== Notes ==
* This hex only affects the duration of enchantments and stances used on the target after the hex is applied, previously applied stances and enchantments are not affected, nor will removing the hex restore the original duration of effects already shortened.
* Faster expiration in this case means a decrease in duration (contrary to Air of Disenchantment).
